ZAF.note: Single digital ID for payments is described as intended, not delivered.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.

facts.fact: The SARB speech says qualifying regional payments are currently carried on SADC-RTGS and are to move to the TCIB system by end-April 2027.

The SARB speech says lower-value retail regional payments run through SADC-RTGS now, with qualifying payments under R100,000 to move to TCIB by end-April 2027 and a hub-and-spoke pilot across eight countries by October 2027.

ZAF.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
Nothing on who operates the national ID system.
Nothing on registers keyed on the ID number.
Nothing on the national ID system itself.

facts.fact: The SARB says it has proposed a new Exemption Notice and Authorisation Framework to let appropriately regulated non-banks perform specified payment activities, with the framework to be published by end-November 2026.

ZAF.note: Only payment-mix figures (cash 56% of payments in 2023), no share of adults with an account.

facts.fact: The SARB says PayShap, a real-time low-value payment rail launched in 2023, has passed 1 billion transactions worth over R1 trillion.

ZAF.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
